observations: Several annotations answer or qualify the questions: non en général for a, Oui toujours for d, non without representability for e, and further normality/completeness hypotheses. The deleted product-condition note and the final conditions à préciser are self-flagged research leads.
The diagonal marginal note and cancelled paragraph at right are among the least secure readings in the package.
